name: Com Vong
summary: Cốm Vòng is young green rice from Vòng village in Cầu Giấy. The tourism center says the grains are gently sweet, soft, and scented with lotus, and that the traditional pairing is ripe banana.
origin: Vòng village, Cầu Giấy, Hanoi. The tourism center says the craft is believed to date back several centuries.
texture: The tourism center says the pounded grains are thin and tender, and the finished rice is soft.
taste: Gentle sweetness, and a subtle lotus fragrance from the leaf wrap.
howToEat: Eat it slowly. The center says it is not a dish you order to fill up.
The traditional pairing is ripe banana. The rice is wrapped in lotus leaves and tied with rice straw.
The center says visitors come in autumn. A shop hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Vòng village, Cầu Giấy ward. The hour is Check on arrival.
